name: w12-flrc-rx-liveness
radio_library_provenance: The pinned RadioLib getFlrcRxStats API exposes three cumulative 16-bit counters (packets, CRC errors, length errors). The diagnostic seam reports them without resetting chip statistics and does not infer packet error rate.

7.name: SNAPSHOT_RX_LIVENESS
7.admission: local control only (from 0, addressed to this node, API or INTERNAL transport), exact prepared run identity, running or complete; no radio mutation
7.read_scope: one operation-time LR2021 FLRC diagnostic seam call; no per-frame or ISR reads

8.name: REARM_RX_LIVENESS
8.admission: local control only, exact current run, destination board, running receiver window, no active TX, no queued TX, and unused one-shot rearm budget
8.effect: on a supported LR2021 FLRC interface, calls the existing RadioLibInterface::startReceive() virtual exactly once at the interface boundary; consumes budget only after the call is performed; rejected guards do not mutate state
8.read_scope: records software state before and after, then takes one operation-time LR2021 FLRC diagnostic seam call

9.name: SNAPSHOT_PRE_SEND_ATTRIBUTION
9.admission: exact local self control and prepared running or complete run; read-only board-local snapshot
9.probe_scope: receiver snapshot required before eligible rearm; source snapshot only with explicit --source-pre-send and a supporting source image

report.header: bytes 0..23 match existing reports: magic u16, version u8, kind u8, run_id/source/destination/elapsed_ms u32, status u8, pending_tx_count u8, two reserved bytes
fields: monotonic report sequence reset by RESET
owner Time::getMillis() when the operation-time seam sample begins
saturating count of performed op8 calls
0 never performed, 1 software armed after call, 2 software not armed after call
software state bits: isReceiving bit0, rxOffline bit1, IRQ attachment bits2..3, attachment-valid bit4
absolute owner millis timestamp, zero if never performed
unsigned micros delta for the performed call, zero if never performed
fresh IRQ flags from the diagnostic seam when read succeeds
fresh LR2021 status bytes data[0..1], zero if IRQ read fails
existing RadioLib result; INT16_MIN means seam unavailable
cumulative getFlrcRxStats packet counter, no reset
cumulative getFlrcRxStats CRC counter, no reset
cumulative getFlrcRxStats length counter, no reset
existing RadioLib result; INT16_MIN means seam unavailable
fresh instantaneous RSSI; INT16_MIN means invalid/unavailable
existing RadioLib result; INT16_MIN means seam unavailable
owner software state with atomic IRQ attachment; not a hardware RX assertion
report.sample_status_scope: Bits 8 and 16 describe the current operation-time sample: they are set for an op8 sample after the rearm call and are clear on a later op7 sample. Historical performed state is carried by rearm_count and rearm_result.
report.result_rules: Only existing RadioLib return values are reported. INT16_MIN is the unavailable sentinel; no synthetic hardware error code is created. startReceive() is void, so op8 reports software armed/not-armed outcome rather than inventing a RadioLib result.
report.safety_rules: No automatic watchdog, IRQ-mask change, chip-stat reset, ISR SPI, or per-frame SPI is added. The LR2021 seam performs the existing operation-time getFlrcRxStats, IRQ/status, and RSSI reads only when op7 or performed op8 requests a page.
